summary: Banzai International, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to 15,000,000 shares of Class A Common Stock for resale by a selling securityholder (YA II PN, LTD, a Yorkville affiliate) pursuant to a standby equity purchase agreement (SEPA) and related registration rights. No new securities are being offered by the issuer; the filing is a routine shelf takedown to satisfy registration obligations. The issuer will not receive any proceeds from resales. There are no deal terms, acquisition/divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change elements. This is an ordinary registration for a pre-existing equity line.
